scope: registered top-view deliveries only; one default variant per device
animationRule: open_idle else greatest playable baked frame count; independent forced loops

textureProfile.colorFilter: formal Q85 WebP at selected size
textureProfile.dataFilter: nearest for packed height/flow coordinates; box for continuous data
textureProfile.oddDimensions: 64px: pad odd right/bottom then halve; 128px: original
textureProfile.maskPolicy: static height comparison offline; lossless WebP masks
textureProfile.geometry: source logical pixels and world footprint unchanged
